title: Your network numbers
intro: Your site regularly notes your followers, posts and views, and keeps their history. Your AI can read them to answer you (“how many followers did I gain this month?”). Nothing shows on your site until you choose it.
noticeLastFailed: The last update did not go through. The site will try again by itself; your earlier numbers are kept.
staleReminder: {platform} ({account}) has not been updated for {days} days. Remember to note today's number, further down.
updateDone: Done: your numbers are up to date.
updateTooSoon: Your numbers were just updated. Try again in a few minutes.
updateBusy: An update is already running. Wait a moment.
updateFailed: The update did not go through. Try again a little later.
emptyAuto: None of your networks shares its numbers yet: open your Twitch or YouTube module and tick “Follow my statistics”. For Instagram, TikTok, X or Facebook, note your numbers by hand, further down.
emptyAutoShort: None of your networks shares its numbers by itself yet: open your Twitch or YouTube module and tick “Follow my statistics”.
evoNone: Not enough history to compare yet.
reason_auth: {platform} needs your permission: open your {platform} module and reconnect your account.
reason_auth_twitch: Twitch needs your permission: click “Connect my channel”.
reason_rate: {platform} asks you to wait a little. Nothing to do: the number will come back by itself.
reason_network: {platform} is not answering right now. Nothing to do: the number will come back by itself.
reason_hidden: {platform} hides this number: make it public in your {platform} account.
reason_hidden_youtube: YouTube hides your subscriber count: make it public in YouTube Studio.
reason_config: Your {platform} module is not set up properly yet: open it and check your account name.
reason_missing: {platform} no longer shares this number: open your {platform} module and tick “Follow my statistics”.
headingShow: What you show on your site
showHelp: “Show on my site” lets visitors see a number; without your say-so it stays for you alone.
showComing: Showing numbers on the site is coming soon: your choices are already kept.
showYes: Yes, show it on my site
manualHelp: Some networks (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook…) do not give their numbers by themselves. Note your follower count here from time to time: the site keeps the history and reminds you when the number gets old.
manualEmpty: No account typed by hand yet.
confirmDeleteManual: Delete this account and all its history? This cannot be undone.
confirmForget: Erase this number and all its history? This cannot be undone.
fOtherNetworkHelp: Only if your network is not in the list.
err_platform: Pick a network, or type its name.
err_value: The number must be a whole number, 0 or more.
err_future: This date is in the future.
err_automatic: {platform} already gives this number by itself for this account: no need to note it by hand.
err_tooMany: You already follow many accounts. Erase one before adding another.
goneHelp: These networks no longer share their numbers. Your history is kept; erase it only if you no longer need it.
notFound: Not found: the page may already be up to date.
footerAdvanced: How often numbers are updated and how long the history is kept are set in this module's settings, in advanced mode.
